integrity: Complete proof, source comparison, reproducibility checker, self-review; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only odd-sided regular right bipyramids, isotropic orthographic projection, all-vertex silhouette event, and almost-sure nondegenerate orientations. Exact optimizer specified by a unique scalar root. Oldest exactly dated inspected arXiv source appeared 2007-02-14, but an earlier 2006 conference predecessor exists; publication priority for the present theorem is not independently certified.
title: Exact maximal-shadow law and unique optimum for odd regular bipyramids
